candidate_selection: Numerically valid candidate maximizing the minimum dense/adapter median ratio across all twenty development workloads; ties prefer eager. Freeze selected backend and all candidate checkpoints before fresh timing confirmation.
timing_gate: For every task, batch, condition and forward/backward mode, dense median seconds / selected adapter median seconds >= 1.05. All numerical, causal and source-identity checks must also pass.
compilation: Report actual first scripted construction CPU/wall, all raw warmup times, outer CPU including startup/compilation/warmup, and compile break-even where steady savings are positive. No assumed free compilation.
scope: Exact same trained Flow implementation comparison only. The decoder batching optimization is architecture-independent and does not establish analytical-vs-ordinary model advantage, full training economics, GPU, energy or production readiness.
